about: Animations at 120 Hz (docs/adr/0018-several-displays.mdx): AnimatedProbe on an output paced as a 120 Hz display (`outputs` 1280x720:120), whose refresh the compositor tells the window before its first configure. The host paces everything by it, never by an assumed 60 Hz: Animated's native driver steps its three 600 ms linear animations once a refresh, each frame's value where a linear animation is at that frame's time within a 120 Hz frame, about 72 frames in the 600 ms where 60 Hz takes 36 (native-animated.json); a 600 ms Animated.timing in JavaScript commits once a frame of requestAnimationFrame, which runs once a refresh, 8.3 ms apart. With the host's frames paced at 60 Hz, each runs about 36 frames 16.7 ms apart and it fails.

steps.name: a press on Start runs the three animations on the native driver at 120 Hz: twice the frames of 60 Hz in the same 600 ms, each where a linear animation is at its time, ending exactly at their values

a press on JS runs a 600 ms linear Animated.timing in JavaScript: requestAnimationFrame runs once a 120 Hz refresh, 8.3 ms apart, and each commit's value is where a linear animation is at its frame's time
